comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
3-item Memorial Album related to rare treasures found in the Temple of Poseidon endless dungeon located inside the Acropolis of Atlantis -- it can only be completed by diving into certain hidden passages (treasure rooms - no enemies or torches, just chests) and opening treasure chests. The MA items are:

Crown of Sacred Tree
Rose Gold Headdress
Warrior Sandals

Reward: Blue Gem Necklace
Received from: Durer (Lubeck)

Note: the above items will NOT appear if you have the Between Myth and Reality TH active; it changes the contents of treasure chests completely. Keep that in mind; cheers.
